notes:
May 30th 2026
Version 10.5+ (stable) / 10.6+(beta)
**********************
NEW!
* New Roland menu → UPG Integrity Check submenu — validates any open tree, OR pick any folder (USB root, /home, anywhere) and the tool recursively finds + checks every .UPG/.UPB/.UPA/.UPL file underneath. Results shown as a sortable per-file table (double-click any row for full findings) (R)
* Right-click on any Roland tree → "Validate Entire Tree" — instant integrity check for the file you're looking at (R)
* Shared UPG Repository upload now BLOCKS corrupt UPGs before they're sent — a styled findings dialog explains exactly what's wrong so the original 12 corrupt files we caught at the source today can never happen again (R)
* Live UPG Editor → Import .UPG now BLOCKS corrupt files before pushing to the accordion's Working Area — same protection, same clear explanation if a file fails (R)
* Live UPG Editor: every UPG load is now silently validated and any issues are written to the diagnostic log — kdiag bundles from future support tickets surface corruption automatically without the user noticing anything (R)
* Changed all labels/sections to match users manual and list page numbers for reference.
* F.Bass section editor: new "Noise / Growl / Effects" tab adds editing for Reed Growl (16' + 8'-4' triplets), Button Noise, Reverb/Chorus/Delay sends, and Detune — closes a long-standing parity gap with Roland's own editor (R)
* Orch Bass section: new "Drum Link" tab lets you assign 3 drum hits (note + volume per drum) that trigger alongside left-hand bass notes — matches the Roland editor (R)
* Live Editor Master Tune tab: now reads the accordion's current values when you open the tab, so clicking Send no longer risks pushing widget defaults (440 Hz, C=0, UPG Filter Off) over your real LCD-configured settings (R)
* Live Editor Master Tune: if you start editing the slider / Transpose combo / UPG Filter checkbox right after opening, the background auto-Read no longer overwrites your in-progress changes (R)
* Live Editor: opening the editor no longer leaves a stray "unsaved changes" asterisk on the Active Sections page when the accordion is in a layered state (e.g. Bass & Chord blinking from Stradella muting) (R)
* Release Notes window: redesigned with the modern dark theme — date headers, version sublines, horizontal dividers between releases, and small color-coded R/K chips so you can see at a glance which side each item applies to (R K)
* Three more dialogs modernized to the consistent dark theme — UPG Detail popup (double-click any UPG in the tree), Roland Settings (model + expansion-slot config), and the Tone List Query window (R)

May 31st 2026
Version 10.5+ (stable) / 10.7+(beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Improved accuracy of reverb, chorus, and delay type names in Set Common. (R)

* Clearer label for the 2nd Bass MIDI Out control. (R)

* New one-click "Sync from Accordion" button on the main screen. (R)

* Smarter handling of multiple launches keeps your edits safe. (R K)

* New master "Status" toggle makes Function Switch assignments easier to manage on FR-4x. (R)

* Friendlier feedback when the accordion isn't responding. (R)

* Broader and deeper FR-4x support across MIDI, Layout, and querying. (R)

* New Layout configuration tab for FR-4x. (R)

* New on-hover tooltips show the accordion's LCD short-names for easy cross-reference. (R)

* New MIDI Filters panel for per-section MIDI message control. (R)

* New Expression MIDI Tx panel with per-section toggles. (R)

* New Start/Stop Tx toggle for MIDI clock transmission. (R)

* New Organ Aftertouch Tx toggle (FR-8x). (R)

* Automatic per-model MIDI parameter routing. (R)

* Clearer "Reed Range" labeling on bass/chord/freebass editors. (R)

* Consistent naming across all section editors. (R)

* Polished labels and tooltips throughout the FR-Editor. (R)

* More reliable dialog rendering on macOS. (R K)

* More robust build and release pipeline. (R K)

* Stronger protection for your expansion-pack settings. (R)
